assets.prompt: Create a clean production background plate from the referenced Land Explorer mockup. A premium claymation preschool game title lockup reading exactly ‘Land Explorer’. Chunky hand-shaped deep teal clay letters mounted on a softly rounded pale beechwood plaque, with two small fresh green clay leaves as balanced accents. Front-facing, centered, warm tactile studio lighting, charming handmade fingerprints, crisp spelling and generous margins. Isolated on one perfectly flat bright magenta background with no shadows beyond the object, no other words, no characters, no UI. Wide horizontal composition.

A precise 2 by 2 contact sheet of four coordinated claymation Montessori landform cards, one complete card centered in each equal square cell. Objects isolated on one perfectly flat dark charcoal background, orthographic top-down view, cohesive tactile clay texture and warm studio light.

Premium handmade clay and toy materials, warm tactile studio lighting, clear silhouettes, consistent scale family. No words, letters, numbers, hands, borders between cells, or extra objects.
